prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported whiplash. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1275; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane of a multi-lane roadway in Sugar Land, Texas, when Driver 2 moved from the adjacent lane into the same space without adequate clearance. The vehicles made contact along their right and left sides respectively, producing scraping damage consistent with a sideswipe. Driver 1 pulled to the right shoulder after the impact. Passenger, who was seated in the front passenger position of Driver 1's vehicle, was present at the scene and confirmed to me that they had been riding in the vehicle at the time. Driver 1 stated that they felt neck stiffness and were experiencing symptoms consistent with whiplash, but it is not yet clear whether any injury resulted from this collision. Photographs taken at the scene confirm the position of both vehicles and the damage reported, and the physical damage appears to match the described impact. No independent witnesses came forward. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle is known to me. Driver 1 is understood to reside with the policyholder and is listed as a member of that household. Both drivers exchanged information, and no citations were issued at the scene pending further review.
